summary: Keep the new-since cursor honest about what a run actually covered, make --page walk the client-side-filtered result set, and hold the HTTP MCP transport to loopback.
reason: Review found this CLI reporting or persisting progress it had not made. sync --saved announced a cursor advance it deliberately does not perform; new discarded the postings mirror-write error and advanced the cursor anyway, and separately advanced it from a --max-pages-capped partial scan while presenting that partial count as the whole result set; find handed --page to the API as a raw offset even when client-side filters were active, so the offset sliced the unfiltered stream and dropped matches from earlier server pages. Independently, the generated MCP entrypoint defaulted to ':7777', exposing the registered local-data and local-write tools on every interface with no authentication. That entrypoint is generator-owned and marked DO NOT EDIT, so a plain regen silently restores the all-interface default; the loopback guard must be re-applied. The fix mirrors the pattern the maintainer already applied to peekaboo's cmd/peekaboo-pp-mcp/main.go.
validated_outcome: go build ./..., go vet ./..., go test ./... (12 packages), go test -race ./internal/cli/, and verify_skill.py all pass. Focused regression tests cover filtered-set paging, unfiltered server paging, the sync cursor-ownership message, an aborted mirror write leaving the cursor untouched, a curtailed scan reporting itself and preserving unreached ids, and loopback-only HTTP MCP binding; each fails against the pre-fix code.
